title: Kissed with Smoke Japanese Rice Inari-Style Sushi
description: Sour and crispy Inari-style sushi dish featuring green chilli, made in a weeknight-friendly manner, originating from the Chugoku region of Japan.

ingredients.name: Kombu dashi
ingredients.notes: optional for added depth of flavor

instructions: Combine Japanese short-grain rice and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and cover with a tight-fitting lid.
Simmer for 18 minutes or until the water has been absorbed.
In a separate saucepan, combine rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, and heat over low heat, stirring until the sugar and salt have dissolved.
Transfer the cooked rice to a large bowl and gently fold in the vinegar mixture.
Cut the smoked tofu into small cubes and set aside.
Prepare a bowl of cold water and add a few ice cubes.
Submerge the nori sheets in the cold water for about 30 seconds to make them pliable.
Remove the nori sheets from the water and place a nori sheet flat on a sushi rolling mat or a clean tea towel.
Spread a thin layer of Japanese short-grain rice onto the nori, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Place a few cubes of smoked tofu and some chopped green chilli in the middle of the rice.
Roll the sushi using the mat or the tea towel, applying gentle pressure.
Cut the sushi into individual pieces and serve immediately.
